messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE: prod-edge-lb-health (sev2) — automatic page fired by PagerDuty integration
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: prod-edge-lb-health triggered 3 mins ago — urgent, unacked. Escalation policy: SRE oncall -> senior SRE.
jessica (oncall): acked the page :white_check_mark: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking dashboards.
alex (sre): on my way, sending a quick heads-up — I'm looking at LB target health and edge TLS handshakes.
mohammed (network): seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures at the edge (~ 15% handshake_err over baseline) and increased 503s to the regional LB. dig/nslookup shows some recent TTL changes for the edge alias.
li (runtime): getting KV cache errors in the runtime logs, but token pipeline looks fine. sharing a grep output:
```
2026-03-15T21:02:13Z runtime-0 kv_cache: miss id=0x4f3a handshake=ok
2026-03-15T21:02:14Z runtime-0 connection: tls_handshake_error peer=10.12.4.5:443 err=ERR_SSL_BAD_RECORD_MAC
2026-03-15T21:02:14Z runtime-1 connection: 503 to backend pool-edge-a
```
chao (eng): from app logs, a lot of client retries leading to higher p95 latency. Customers hitting inference endpoints in eu-west.
katie (support): we already have two customers reporting elevated latency and timeouts. CS is triaging and collecting request IDs.
jessica (oncall): initial triage: TLS handshake errors to front-door, LB target pool 'edge-eu-west' has ~40% unhealthy targets. probable cause: backend instances failing health checks after a config push? checking deploy dashboard.
alex (sre): I see a deployment completed 12:56 UTC to the eu-west pool earlier, but rollout shows <1% failure. healthcheck path /health returns 200 locally. pulling recent host-level errors.
mohammed (network): running dig and curl tests from multiple regions:
```
# from us-east
dig +short edge.redwood.ai
-> 34.120.8.12 (ttl 30)
# from eu-west
curl -v https://edge.redwood.ai/health
* TLS handshake failure: alert handshake_failure
```
ops-runner-bot: Runbook snippet: if LB targets unhealthy and TLS errors, consider: (1) fail traffic to healthy region, (2) roll back recent config, (3) notify customers.
jessica (oncall): status update: Paging senior SRE per escalation. @alex can you take lead on mitigation? I'll keep PD/comms and customer notes.
alex (sre): taking lead. proposed immediate mitigations: 1) shift weight away from eu-west to us-east (gradual 30% -> 100%), 2) mark unhealthy targets for replacement, 3) test TLS certs on edge proxies.
li (runtime): quick check: cert rotation job ran ~21:00 UTC but finished with no errors. cert expiry not the issue (valid until 2027). runtime stacks show 'ERR_SSL_BAD_RECORD_MAC' which often indicates mismatched ciphers or middlebox interference.
mohammed (network): possible mismatch between ALB -> edge-proxy cipher lists after recent proxy config change. I'm pulling ALB listener configs now.
chao (eng): rolling back the proxy config is feasible but will take ~8-12min to cutover. we can weight-shift as a quicker mitigation.
jessica (oncall): comms: support posted initial status to the status page — "Degraded performance for inference endpoints in EU while we investigate". Katie please keep CS updated with request IDs and rough ETA.
katie (support): ack. collecting affected customer IDs and request traces now.
alex (sre): executing weight-shift. initiating gradual traffic reweighting script:
```
# reweight script (dry run)
./reweight.sh --from eu-west --to us-east --percent 30
```
alex (sre): starting 30% shift now. monitoring error rates and p95.
mohammed (network): after 30% shift, eu-west TLS errors dropped from 15% -> 9%. requesting 60% next.
li (runtime): runtime error queues dropping proportionally, KV misses unchanged. latency p95 in eu-west still elevated but improving.
jessica (oncall): PagerDuty: notifying on-call rotation and PD notes updated. assigning incident lead alex, comms jessica, customer liaison katie.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alex escalated to senior-sre, PD notes updated.
alex (sre): increasing shift to 70%. please hold 2 mins for observation.
chao (eng): while we reweight, I'll prepare a rollback of the proxy change (PR #4567). if reweight doesn't reach healthy steady state we'll rollback.
mohammed (network): config diff shows recent proxy cipher list removed TLS1.3-only fallback. re-adding TLS1.3 preferred list looks safe. preparing to apply to a canary.
li (runtime): performed a canary request to canary-proxy after re-adding ciphers -> handshake success.
katie (support): customer update drafted: "We are mitigating a regional edge issue causing increased latency/timeouts in EU. We have shifted traffic and are actively investigating root cause. No data loss. ETA next update in 30 mins." approve? :eyes:
jessica (oncall): approved, post now.
ops-runner-bot: Reminder: document mitigation steps and request IDs in incident timeline.
alex (sre): 70% shift completed. eu-west TLS errors down to 2.1%, 503s down 85% from peak. rolling remainder to 100% over 4m.
mohammed (network): applying proxy cipher fix to canary and monitoring.
li (runtime): after canary applied, runtime handshake errors to canary=0. replicating to rest of proxies in eu-west.
chao (eng): applying rollback (proxy config update) across pool now. this will trigger rolling restarts of proxy pods — expected 10m impact on new connections.
jessica (oncall): customer impact: multiple customers saw increased latency and some timed-out requests. we've identified impacted customer set and CS is contacting top 5. No evidence of data corruption. Recording as Sev2.
katie (support): Top-5 customer outreach in progress; one customer reported degraded SLAs. they're on an emergency call; sharing request IDs.
alex (sre): post-fix metrics: eu-west TLS errors < 0.5%, LB target healthy count back to normal. rolling metrics look good for 12 minutes.
mohammed (network): verification: TLS handshake logs show cipher negotiation restored to TLS1.3 preferred. looks clean.
chao (eng): remote proxy pods restarted and healthchecks are green. rolling finished.
jessica (oncall): closing loop: incident containment achieved via traffic weight shift and proxy config rollback. preparing next steps: root cause analysis, follow-up postmortem, and action items: (1) add automatic cipher compatibility test in canary, (2) tighten deploy gating on proxy config changes, (3) update runbook for TLS-related LB health pages.
alex (sre): assigning RCA owner: chao will own postmortem. ETA 48h.
katie (support): posting customer follow-ups and drafted the incident summary for account teams.
incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated (containment). Please file postmortem: https://redwood-internal/incident/4987654322
jessica (oncall): thanks team. great cross-functional job. I'll leave the channel open for any late regressions. :slightly_smiling_face:
